text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Soccer: Tunisia beat Namibia 2-1 in preliminaries for the Mundial 1998 and leads its African zone group two at a match played on Sunday in Windhoek.
- Tunisia on Monday celebrates World Health Day.
- 14 countries take part in the 2000 km-long Tunisian Motor Rally which starts on Monday.
- Tunisia plans to modernise state-controlled vehicles assembling firm STIA.
- The high Planning Committee meets this week for the approval of the final draft of Tunisia's Economic Development 9th plan 1997-2001.
- Trade Minister Mondher Zenaidi on Monday to open a Seminar on modernisation of the textiles sector. Mediterranean textiles exhibit "TEXMED" to be held on November 12-15 in Tunis.
